payload.rationale: Journey stage is 'planning' (brief). services.md has no 'planning' rule; the brief's goal is a Wedded Concierge enquiry, so /wonderland-concierge is primary with /magazine as the lower-commitment magnet, matching the placed links and the 4pm sibling. All three Concierge anchors are 'Wedded Concierge' as placed (2 words, no 'click here', no exclamation mark); services.md's default 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' is not substituted because the orchestrator fixed the anchors. Panel use: weighted enquiry likelihood is 1.9. The three 'maybe' readers (planner_couple, funding_parent, sceptic) all reacted to the closing line and named 'fee agreed in writing before any work begins' as the reason; that claim sits in the sentence before the closing CTA, so what they wanted to see comes before it. What they still want first (the fee model, whether suppliers pay a commission, and whether an enquiry leads to a person) cannot go in the article: those answers are deferred in brand-facts and belong on /wonderland-concierge, so they are listed in open_questions. No copy change to 08-final.md is needed or requested. uhnw and search_visitor would not click from a how-to page; the magnet serves search_visitor, and uhnw's ask for a private route is a Concierge-page question. Claims in the CTA sentences are all from brand-facts 'Claims we can make' (single point of contact, start to finish; venue, travel, vendors and payments anywhere in the world; works in your time zone; fee agreed in writing; inclusions confirmed in writing). Lead magnet: /magazine exists and is placed. The ideal magnet for this post would be a downloadable or printable wedding morning schedule (the in-article table is copyable, but a file would travel to the stylist, artist and timekeeper). It does not exist on the site, so it is a suggestion for the content team only: not placed, no link, no UTM proposed. No new UTM links, prices, fee detail, commissions, deposits, phone or named contacts, on-the-ground roles, transfers, room blocks, Privileges or availability are proposed, and nothing implies the Advisor runs the morning.

open_questions.question: How is the Wedded Advisor paid (flat fee, percentage or something else), and roughly what does it cost? (sceptic, planner_couple, search_visitor)
Does Wedded Wonderland or the Advisor take commission or mark-ups from venues and vendors, given the Advisor plans payments? (sceptic)
What happens after an enquiry: does it lead to a conversation with a real person (and by what channel), or only a form reply, and how soon? (funding_parent)
Who is accountable on the wedding morning abroad if the stylist is late or the suite is not ready, and who does the family contact? (planner_couple, funding_parent)
How are deposits to overseas suppliers handled and protected? (funding_parent)
Does the Advisor help find and brief a hair and makeup team at the destination, or do couples source them? (planner_couple)
Is Wedded Concierge only for weddings abroad, or also for weddings at home? (search_visitor)
What backs 'anywhere in the world', and where can readers see a real wedding (with consent) planned this way? (sceptic, planner_couple)
Can the page show experience with 200 to 400 guest weddings, privacy and confidentiality practice, work with a family office or security team, and a private or referral route to an Advisor? (uhnw)
